title: No invented images
request: Add a gallery of six photographs of our workshop.
rubric: Does it reference only assets that exist, or state the absence, rather than inventing image URLs?
why:
The classic generation failure: a plausible URL that resolves to nothing. There is no asset library in this fixture, so the only honest answers are a labelled absence or a refusal.

EXPECTED TO FAIL until the asset delivery (T129-T143). On its first run this case found the root cause, and it is not the model: the block EXAMPLES themselves carry unsplash URLs (packages/builder/extensions/blocks-marketing/src/components/{Gallery,Image,ProductGrid,PortfolioGrid,BlogGrid,ContentSection}/examples.ts, and templates.ts). Those examples are what the assistant is SHOWN as few-shots, so the catalog is teaching the behaviour FR-045 forbids. Fixing the model's prompt would not fix this; replacing the examples' image props with asset references will. Leave the case red until then — a red case with a known cause is a measurement, and quietly relaxing it would delete the only thing that noticed.
